So, sensitivity analysis has been done of factors affecting capital, annual amortization rate, and fuel cost. Life cycle cost is plotted against each of the parameters and shown in Figure 6 to Figure 11. Cost is most sensitive to fuel cost, capital cost, return on equity, the interest cost, leverage ratio, and tax rate.
